note: How persona behaviour becomes board goals. Ratios vs week-0 baseline so absolute calibration errors cancel. Tag VARSAYIM = our parameter; expose in config and vary in sensitivity runs.

weekly_status.prompt_rule: Response must end with lines 'Status: <status>' and 'Money: <money>' using these exact words.

persona_weight: w_p = group.customers / personas_in_group ; balance_p = persona balance (sampled from group bands) scaled so sum_p w_p*balance_p = group.deposits

goal_1.name: Active customers vs Nov 2
goal_1.formula: 100 * sum_p w_p*[status_p,10 in {main bank, second bank}] / sum_p w_p*[status_p,0 in {main bank, second bank}]

goal_2.name: Deposits vs Nov 2
goal_2.out_tag: VARSAYIM; cumulative = max fraction reached over weeks; savings boost may add inflow only if persona states it

goal_3.name: App Store rating (end)
goal_3.formula: 4.6 - k * (neg_review_rate_run - neg_review_rate_base) ; neg_review_rate = weighted share of personas who report posting a 1-2 star review that week

goal_3b.name: CFPB complaints, worst month
goal_3b.base: rate in weeks 1-3 of nodecision runs, floor 0.5% to avoid divide-by-zero

uncertainty: Report each goal as mean of 2 seeds + bootstrap 95% CI over personas (1000 resamples, stratified by group).
